name: bad-input
summary: A null field in the JSON body makes POST /api/items dereference null, throwing an uncaught TypeError that crashes the process with a real stack trace.
expected_log_signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'trim')
ground_truth: POST /api/items calls payload.name.trim() without validating the request body. A JSON body whose name field is null makes that call dereference null, throwing an uncaught TypeError inside the request handler with no try/catch; Node prints the stack trace and terminates the process.
